title: Former employee retains ticket access
event_and_consequence: An offboarding task is missed, allowing a former employee to read or export tickets.
existing_safeguards: Manual leaver checklist; manager notifications are assumed but not reconciled to system exports.
likelihood_rationale: The fixture contains an active departed user and manual handoffs recur at each departure.
impact_rationale: Customer ticket exposure could harm multiple customers and trigger contractual investigation.
target_rationale: Central leaver reconciliation and review reduce recurrence; an undetected account can still expose tickets.

title: Unjustified privilege enables major compromise
event_and_consequence: A compromised or misused privileged account changes infrastructure or repositories beyond its business need.
existing_safeguards: Some named administrator approvals and MFA are assumed; privileged assignments are not reviewed systematically.
likelihood_rationale: One unjustified repository administrator exists in the fixture and routine reviews are absent.
impact_rationale: Privileged misuse could affect every tenant or the software release chain.
target_rationale: Approval and strong authentication reduce exposure; a successful privileged compromise remains severe.

title: Role change leaves excessive ticket permissions
event_and_consequence: A sales employee retains support-agent permissions and accesses customer ticket content without a current need.
existing_safeguards: Department role matrix exists as a fictional baseline; role-change triggers are informal.
likelihood_rationale: Role changes occur periodically and the fixture shows one mismatch against approved access.
impact_rationale: Inappropriate ticket access could expose customer conversations and attachments.
target_rationale: Event-driven permission checks reduce recurrence; the impact of missed access remains unchanged.

title: Lost laptop exposes work sessions
event_and_consequence: A stolen laptop with an active session is used to access work information.
existing_safeguards: Screen locking and limited local storage are assumed; encryption and remote-wipe coverage are not verified.
likelihood_rationale: Remote staff carry devices and device safeguards lack a verified inventory.
impact_rationale: A single device could expose a bounded set of work records and sessions.
target_rationale: Verified encryption and session revocation make successful access less likely; exposed sessions still matter.

title: Backups fail to restore after corruption
event_and_consequence: Data corruption is followed by a failed restore, causing extended service loss or unrecoverable tickets.
existing_safeguards: Nightly backups are assumed; no successful restore evidence or isolated recovery copy is available.
likelihood_rationale: Backup jobs exist but recoverability has never been demonstrated in this scenario.
impact_rationale: Failed recovery could cause prolonged all-customer outage and permanent ticket loss.
target_rationale: A tested isolated restore and integrity checks reduce failure likelihood and bound the recovery consequence.

title: Cloud disruption interrupts customer service
event_and_consequence: A supplier or regional disruption interrupts the single-region service beyond customer tolerances.
existing_safeguards: Supplier status monitoring is assumed; no tested service recovery arrangement exists.
likelihood_rationale: A single-region dependency creates a credible interruption path without tested failover.
impact_rationale: A multi-hour service interruption would prevent customer support and breach assumed service commitments.
target_rationale: Redundancy and exercised recovery reduce prolonged interruption likelihood; a severe regional event still matters.

title: Unsafe release weakens tenant isolation
event_and_consequence: An inadequately reviewed change bypasses tenant authorization and exposes another customer's tickets.
existing_safeguards: Peer review is assumed; required security tests and release approvals are not enforced.
likelihood_rationale: Frequent changes and missing negative authorization tests create repeated opportunities.
impact_rationale: Cross-tenant access can expose information across the customer base.
target_rationale: Required reviews and tenant-isolation tests reduce unsafe releases; a missed defect remains severe.

title: Supplier handles customer information improperly
event_and_consequence: A support or hosting supplier retains or discloses customer data contrary to agreed handling expectations.
existing_safeguards: Basic purchasing approvals are assumed; supplier data flows and security terms have not been reviewed.
likelihood_rationale: Several suppliers handle information without a consistent security review.
impact_rationale: Supplier disclosure could expose customer records and undermine commitments.
target_rationale: Due diligence and contractual handling conditions reduce exposure; supplier breaches remain possible.

title: Slow incident response increases harm
event_and_consequence: Unclear escalation and missing investigation records delay containment of suspicious access.
existing_safeguards: Staff can contact the Platform Lead; no exercised incident procedure or consistent event review exists.
likelihood_rationale: Ad hoc escalation and incomplete logging make delayed recognition plausible.
impact_rationale: An uncontained incident can increase ticket exposure and extend downtime.
target_rationale: Logging and exercised escalation reduce delay and limit incident duration; detection is still imperfect.

title: Exposed build secret permits production access
event_and_consequence: A service secret copied into source or build output is obtained and used to access production.
existing_safeguards: A secrets store is assumed; legacy shared tokens and inconsistent scanning remain.
likelihood_rationale: Build and support workflows create recurring copying opportunities with incomplete detection.
impact_rationale: A high-impact secret may enable broad production access or an unauthorized release.
target_rationale: Scoped short-lived credentials, rotation and scanning reduce exposure; a missed powerful secret remains severe.

title: People records shared with the wrong group
event_and_consequence: An overly broad document link exposes employment records to colleagues without a business need.
existing_safeguards: Separate people folder and small authorized group are assumed; link sharing is not periodically checked.
likelihood_rationale: Few record handlers reduce frequency, but unchecked sharing remains a plausible route.
impact_rationale: Exposure would affect a bounded set of employee personal information and trust.
target_rationale: Restricted links and periodic review reduce accidental access; disclosed people records still have material impact.

title: Brief public website outage delays enquiries
event_and_consequence: A brief outage of the separate static marketing website delays prospective customer enquiries.
existing_safeguards: Managed hosting and static content are assumed; existing customers use a separate service URL and email.
likelihood_rationale: A small static site with managed hosting presents limited ordinary outage exposure.
impact_rationale: Only short-term enquiry delay is expected; customer service and customer data are unaffected.
target_rationale: Accept within low-risk appetite while monitoring scope and business dependency changes.
